messages:
Aisha: quick weekly sync for Helio Labs - flagging a couple of odd token/throughput signals. TL;DR: WoW tokens down, QoQ up, midday latency spike, spend creeping. Pls eyeball.

Aisha: small snapshot - skim if short on time:
```
metric | last_week | this_week | delta
tokens | 480k | 423k | -11.8%
p50_ms | 120 | 210 | +75%
5xx_rate | 0.12% | 0.90% | +0.78pp
spend $ | 18.2k | 19.8k | +8.8%
```

Aisha: latency bump concentrated 10:00-13:00 PST yesterday. batch size avg up, KV hit-rate down. @Miguel - can you triage? @Jian - flag for renewal watch?

Miguel: looking. pulling request logs + batching windows now. initial glance shows long-seq tail. scheduling 30m huddle 10:30 PT. inviting Nate for data pull. :mag_right:

Nate: uploaded adhoc pulls to a gist (placeholder): https://gist.github.com/helio-labs-check/placeholder
Nate: quick note from the pulls - ~67% of tokens this week from 3 internal clients; one client shifted to >1024 token seqs around spike window.

Miguel: hypothesis = workload shift -> larger KV miss -> bigger batch processing -> p50 increase. will run KV hit-rate by model-variant + prefix cache.

Priya: recommend enablement: 20m session for Helio devs on prompt windowing + response truncation; include recommended quantization hints. I can prep one-pager.

Jian: renewal POV - usage down WoW but spend up; account-health score moved 74 -> 62 this check. Marking as "watch". Suggest auto-escalate if health <= 60 next week.

deploy-bot: Anomaly AD-4421: correlated model-variant fallback events and latency increase between 2024-09-12T10:05Z and 2024-09-12T12:55Z.

Miguel: seeing fallback markers in selector logs. possible capacity-induced fallback to a quantized variant that increases p50. checking node-level capacity and evictions.

Aisha: agreed action items:
- Miguel + Nate: deep-dive and post CSV + short notes by EOD today.
- Priya: schedule enablement (Tue) 20m + one-pager.
- Jian: mark renewal-risk = watch; CS owner to escalate if health <= 60 next check.

Miguel: adding a follow-up query to isolate per-client batch windows and model-instance IDs.

Nate: I can add a quick prefix-cache hit-rate chart to the CSV; will attach.

Aisha: thanks all. Ill post a short summary in #customer-success tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
